prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Most of the frame in shadow; the brightest value is the flash, the second the bank's gold doorway. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
